anchor_convention: primal - 1e-5 (conservative); dual_lb-only centers set primal = dual_lb + 1e-5
full_box_note: Single-global-grid cover_min on the WIDE box is eps-driven (eps_grid=0.0519, L_max=7.72) -> 0.3297, far below target. This reproduces the prior spot-check 0.376-class number and the candidate's own grid_cover_best=0.3297. The low value is an artifact of the wide q-axis half_diag, NOT a genuine sub-target cover value.
decisive_finding: The cover's low point (worst_point_full) sits at q=-0.05, which is FEASIBLE (SDP solves, val=0.382). The binding slice of the whole region is therefore the FEASIBLE q=-0.05 boundary strip, not any excluded deep-q region. Per the decision rule, the verdict is decided by whether fine subdivision of this FEASIBLE strip clears the target.
monotonicity_note: SDP optimum rises monotonically as |q| grows; the binding (lowest) feasible point is at the q=-0.05 boundary. Deep-q is both higher-valued AND eventually infeasible, so excluding it is irrelevant to the floor.
pointwise_ceiling_note: The eps->0 TRUE cover value (max over all 121 centers, fine 801x1201 grid) at the binding q=-0.05 zone is 0.38164, i.e. +1.36e-3 above target. The genuine cover comfortably clears the target; the only obstruction to certifying it is the residual Lipschitz cell error, which adaptive subdivision drives down.
feasible_certified_floor_method: Rigorous branch-and-bound: partition the feasible 3D strip h[0,0.08] x p[0,1] x q[-0.15,-0.05] into sub-boxes; each sub-box bounded below by cover_min_over_box (grid + per-subbox local Lipschitz eps_grid); a sub-box is closed once its rigorous LB >= target, others split (longest axis) to depth<=26 / eps_floor=2e-4. Floor = min over the partition of the per-subbox rigorous lower bounds. ALL 121 centers used; NO center dropping. 13277 leaves; every sub-box cleared target.
feasible_certified_floor_face_note: Independent cross-check on the 2D q=-0.05 boundary face (q[-0.0501,-0.05]) gave 0.3802850 over 1130 leaves, every sub-box cleared target. The 3D strip (which subsumes the face plus the rising interior) gave 0.3802840. Both >= target.
eps_grid_achieved: 2.1e-3 at the binding leaf (per-subbox local Lipschitz, L_max~2.7 after the wide-box global L_max is localized away); regional floor = leaf grid_min - leaf eps_grid. Worst-leaf grid_min ~ 0.38245, minus eps ~0.00214 -> ~0.38028. Most leaves reach eps < 5e-4; the binding leaf is at depth limit but still clears target.
infeasibility_rigor_note: Deep-q infeasibility is ROBUST: 8 distinct interior points spanning q in [-1.0,-0.40] and p in [0.20,0.50] all return CLARABEL status 'infeasible' at N=4000,T=1600,bochner_n=20. RIGOR CAVEAT: these are CLARABEL numerical 'infeasible' statuses; I did not extract/verify an explicit Farkas dual-ray certificate, so this is solver-attested, not certificate-grade, infeasibility. HOWEVER this caveat does NOT affect the verdict: the certified floor is set by the FEASIBLE q=-0.05 strip (which clears target with all 121 centers, no exclusion needed). The deep-q exclusion only removes points whose cover/SDP value is already >> target (>=0.47-0.52 where feasible near the boundary), so even if some deep-q point were mis-labeled infeasible it could not lower the floor. The candidate's reliance on infeasibility-exclusion is thus a red herring for the floor; the floor stands on the feasible strip alone.
subdivision_note: Established that (a) the wide-box single-grid 0.3297 is purely eps_grid-driven (refuted as a 'real' floor); (b) the worst point is at the FEASIBLE q=-0.05 boundary; (c) the true pointwise cover ceiling there is 0.38164 (+1.36e-3 over target); (d) rigorous branch-and-bound subdivision over the feasible region certifies a floor of 0.380284-0.380285 with ALL 121 centers and NO center dropping, every sub-box clearing the target. The candidate's claimed 0.380309 lies between the eps-limited B&B floor (0.380284) and the true ceiling (0.381639) and is therefore consistent / not an overclaim.
verdict_detail: CONFIRM with caveat on tightness. The feasible certified floor for R6 is >= 0.3802840 > 0.3802838 (target). Confirmed by two independent rigorous branch-and-bound runs (2D face: 0.3802850; 3D feasible strip: 0.3802840), each using all 121 centers with no center-dropping and no reliance on infeasibility exclusion. The margin is razor-thin (+1.7e-7) but positive and stable, and the underlying true cover value at the binding point is 0.38164, a comfortable +1.36e-3 above target -- the thinness is an artifact of residual Lipschitz cell error, not of the cover itself. The candidate's specific number 0.380309 (which dropped 2 spiky centers and subdivided harder) is consistent with, and slightly more aggressive than, this independently reproduced floor.
